speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From the messenger's entrance. Sincler, come in by the middle door and do not hurry the three paces. Let the black cloak do the work before you open your mouth.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Three paces and stop, Will. My ribs are lean enough to look like Lent without running.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: When he stops, I step back a pace, so the line of his back sits between the ladies and us.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: If I take the news before he finishes, sir, the hush goes thin on a stage this wide.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold two beats after he says "The King your father," Nick. At the Cross Keys one beat did it. Here the back of the yard needs the breath.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Two beats, and then "Dead for my life." I can hold it low, so the wind does not take it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Keep it on thy chest, Nick. Thou hast breath enough if thou dost not push at the gallery.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: That carries. Thou couldst hear a pin drop on that turn, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it there on Monday. And Dick, when thou answerest on the twelvemonth and a day, give her the plain voice, not the sonnet voice.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Plain as bread. "That's too long for a play." Watch me drop my hands when I say it.

speaker: john_sincler
text: And I stay by the pillar till the song is done, without shifting my feet?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Still as a post. The black stays while the cuckoo sings.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Now the song, once. Sam, thy throat is a little thick this morning. Sing it smaller.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Smaller. I am not croaking. I can give you the word.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: There. The word came. I am not hoarse.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: It came. Leave it at once. Thick is not a second try.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough while the throat is thick. I am not making a trouble of a note that came.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Clear enough for an empty yard. Monday will tell thee what a full one does to it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: May I do it again, Master Phillips? I did not lose the word.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No. Button thy collar, Sam, and stand out of the wind. Once is the kindness.

speaker: john_sincler
text: I can stand through it. A black cloak is warmer than a song.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have the two beats, sir. I will not take the news early to show I know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not show it, Nick. Hold, and then the line. That is the whole of thy part in the turn.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the plain voice. Thou hast Navarre. I am not asking thee for a new page this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no new page. The comedy is the book in the house. I am walking this entrance, and then I am going home.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nine of the clock tomorrow, and nobody late. Sam stays buttoned.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine tomorrow. Keep him warm, Augustine. I have nothing else for this yard today.

speaker: john_sincler
text: Three paces, then the pillar. I will not invent a fourth.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Go home, Will. The empty yard has had its hush.
